subject: Renewal QBR + Roadmap — consolidate slots for Jan
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@cureleaf.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: team@cureleaf.com
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: QBR timeline — need to collapse slots into one day

Hi Naomi —

Hope you’re well. We’re lining up our Q1 exec week and trying to minimize multi-day reads. For the upcoming renewal/roadmap QBR we were hoping to consolidate the sessions into a single half-day block (technical deep-dive + roadmap + commercial recap). Our current internal exec schedule is tight the week of Jan 9; is there flexibility to run everything on Jan 12 (PST) in a 3-hour block?

If that’s hard for Redwood, can you propose 2–3 contiguous windows across Jan 10–14 so we can circulate to stakeholders? We’ll need a call with our CTO, Head of Data, procurement, and the product sponsor.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Zhao
Director, Product
CureLeaf Health
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@cureleaf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR timeline — need to collapse slots into one day

Thanks Emily — appreciate the heads-up. Jan 12 could work; we do have calendar pressure across our field team but I can propose contiguous windows. Suggested slots (PST):

- Option A: Jan 12, 09:00–12:00 (3 hours) — full-team deep-dive + roadmap
- Option B: Jan 11, 12:00–15:00 (3 hours) — later in day for east-coast execs
- Option C: Jan 13, 08:30–11:30 (3 hours) — earlier start but still contiguous

Before I lock anything, two quick asks:
1) Can you confirm the required attendees (names/titles) so we can include the right Redwood SMEs?
2) Are there specific topics you want in the agenda (e.g., latency SLOs, dedicated capacity pricing, private deployment checklist, migration timeline)?

Attaching a draft agenda for a consolidated half-day — Marissa, Vivek, I can split the session: Marissa will lead the architecture/tech deep-dive; Vivek can cover Dedicated/Private deployment economics and rollouts.

If you prefer, I can create a single calendar invite with a proposed agenda and send to your attendees for quick accept/decline.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior AE, Renewals
Redwood Inference
Attachment: CureLeaf-QBR-Agenda-v2.docx (1 page)
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@cureleaf.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: team@cureleaf.com
Date: Fri, 31 Dec 2027 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR timeline — need to collapse slots into one day

Hi Naomi — thanks for the options. Quick update from our side: CTO Tina Liu is traveling Jan 12–13 and won’t be available for the full block. The product sponsor (Daniel Park) prefers Jan 12 but can shift his calendar if we keep the day earlier. Procurement wants a separate 30-minute follow-up the week after to finalize renewals paperwork.

Can we do Option A but start earlier: Jan 12, 08:30–11:30 PST? That gives Tina one of the early hours before travel. If you can confirm Redwood attendees and the final agenda, I’ll send a calendar hold to Execs and procurement.

One last ask — any pre-read we should circulate? The team would like a one-page summary of migration effort and expected downtime for Private deployments.

Appreciate it — Emily
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@cureleaf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jan 2028 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR timeline — confirm Jan 12 08:30–11:30 PST (calendar invite sent)

Emily — confirmed. We’ll run the consolidated QBR on Jan 12, 2028, 08:30–11:30 PST. Calendar invite attached (calendar-invite-20280112.ics).

Final attendees from Redwood: Naomi Feldman (Renewals lead), Marissa Cole (Solutions — architecture/deep-dive), Vivek Kulkarni (Customer Success — Dedicated/Private economics).

Agenda (condensed):
- 08:30–08:45: Introductions & renewal objectives (Naomi)
- 08:45–09:30: Architecture deep-dive + KV/cache patterns for multi-tenant workloads (Marissa)
- 09:30–10:00: Dedicated vs. Hosted economics / autoscale + burst (Vivek)
- 10:00–10:30: Migration plan & Private deployment checklist — pre-reads (Marissa)
- 10:30–11:00: Contract recap, procurement asks, next steps (Naomi)

Pre-reads attached: one-page migration summary (in the agenda doc) and a drive folder with technical notes. I’ll also create the calendar invite and include the DocuSign link for the amendment once procurement confirms the final T&Cs.

See you Jan 12.

Best,
Naomi
Senior AE, Renewals
Redwood Inference
Attachments: CureLeaf-QBR-Agenda-v2.docx, calendar-invite-20280112.ics
